_comment: Canonical per-model rate + limit table for build-with-team (SC9). Replaces cost-rates.json — build-helpers reads this file directly. Dimension-selectable shape: top-level `model` and `pricing` dims, both populated here (full canonical source); build-helpers implements subset-selection + minification at read time, this on-disk copy stays fully populated and human-readable. `pricing.contract` is reserved empty — a consumer prefers a model's `contract` entry over `list` when present; no contract rates exist yet.
_source: Anthropic Claude API docs. Rate table + context/output limits + batch discount + cache-rate multipliers cite platform.claude.com/docs pricing, models-overview, prompt-caching, and batch-processing pages. Two fields resolved via WebFetch on 2026-07-03: (1) `model.*.knowledge_cutoff` — https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/about-claude/models/overview.md ("Reliable knowledge cutoff" row); (2) `model.*.min_cacheable_prefix` — all 7 values taken from the same-day fetch of https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/build-with-claude/prompt-caching.md ("minimum cacheable prompt length" list), superseding the spike's earlier figures for a single consistent provenance (see _min_cacheable_prefix_note).
_min_cacheable_prefix_note: All 7 min_cacheable_prefix values come from one source: the 2026-07-03 live prompt-caching doc fetch (fable-5=512, opus-4-8=1024, opus-4-7=2048, opus-4-6=4096, sonnet-5=1024, sonnet-4-6=1024, haiku-4-5=4096). These supersede an earlier spike's figures, which predated this fetch. This field is non-load-bearing metadata — no SC2/SC5 consumer reads it — so re-verify all 7 against the live doc at the next anthropic-specs refresh.

claude-sonnet-5._introductory_pricing: Standard $3 in / $15 out applied above. $2 in / $10 out introductory rate applies through 2026-08-31, reverting to standard on 2026-09-01 — not applied here; refresh this file when the reversion lands if introductory-period accuracy is needed sooner.
